clauses.clause_label: Limited license to use, copy, modify, and incorporate Examples
clauses.scope_note: LucidLink grants the recipient a limited, non-exclusive, revocable license covering the Examples: use, copying, and modification, and incorporation in whole or in part into the recipient’s own applications and integrations that access or use LucidLink services. The Applicable Terms are either the linked LucidLink Terms and Conditions or a separate written agreement with LucidLink governing the recipient’s use of LucidLink services; the text does not specify which applies to a particular recipient.
clauses.condition_explanation: The grant applies only while the recipient continues to comply with the Applicable Terms. Which terms apply depends on whether the recipient or its organization has entered into the described separate written agreement.

clauses.scope_note: The recipient may not redistribute the Examples as a standalone code sample set or as part of a product whose primary purpose is to compete with LucidLink. This clause does not establish a general prohibition on other forms of distribution; the text grants no express distribution permission for them.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies if either the redistribution is as a standalone code sample set or the product containing the Examples has the primary purpose of competing with LucidLink.

coverage_notes: The text identifies the LucidLink Terms and Conditions by URL, but does not supply their contents; any separate written agreement is also not supplied. Their additional conditions cannot be determined here.
The supplied text concerns proprietary LucidLink example scripts and code samples, not a general open-source license. It states that the Examples are not licensed under an open-source license.
The text grants no rights by implication, estoppel, or otherwise. It contains no operative terms here on fees, source provision, attribution, training, or output rights.
